title: Governing Persistent Agent Memory: code and data (AIEI 2027, paper 1223)
description: Code, raw results and checking scripts for the paper 'Governing Persistent Agent Memory: A Causal Study of Authority, Trust, and Recency' (AIEI 2027). CLAIMS.md maps every statement in the paper to its code, result file and check; verify_claims.py re-checks every number.
